headline: Nursing Aide
summary: Nursing aide with three years on the medical ward of a hospital in Butuan. I help patients with personal care and mobility, give medicines under nurse supervision, take vital signs and keep the ward clean and safe. I respond quickly in emergencies and communicate well with nurses and families.
skills: Vital signs and basic patient checks
Charting vital signs and care given

experience.title: Nursing Aide
bullets: Assist 12 to 15 patients per shift with bathing, feeding, turning and walking.
Give oral medicines under the nurse's supervision and record them on the chart.
Take and chart vital signs every four hours and report abnormal readings right away.
Follow infection control rules for isolation rooms and clean equipment between patients.

experience.title: Caregiver
bullets: Looked after a bedridden client at home and helped the family with daily care.
Reported changes in the client's condition to the family and the home-visit nurse.
